Enhanced Wonders for Historical Owners
Introduction
Historical Owners
Basic Concepts

This page comes from the mod "Enhanced Wonders for Historical Owners". When this mod is on, players will get the following three effects:[NEWLINE][ICON_BUllet] The historical owner of a certain Wonder gains +50% [ICON_Production] production while building the Wonder.[NEWLINE][ICON_BUllet] Historical owners of Wonders receive unique bonuses from wonders (check the following pages for detailed information).[NEWLINE][ICON_BUllet] If there is no (Major Civ) Historical owner for certain Wonder in Civ6, players can unlock unique bonuses by completing a unique project.

In addition, to make game easier, players can turn on the "Enhanced Wonders for Historical Owners: Only Human Gain Buff" mode when creating a game. With this game mode on, only human players can receive bonuses from their historical-owned Wonders.

We've put a lot of effort into compatibility, so this mod supports all three game rules, runs with the base game, and automatically adds bonuses to all Wonders in DLCs. To ensure compatibility, all historical owner bonuses are independent of the original effect. Therefore, this mod is theoretically compatible with all Wonders Enhanced, Weakened, and Balanced modules, as well as two large modules (Harmony in Diversity & Golden Ages).
In order not to conflict with the descriptions of the Wonder effects of other mods, all the descriptions of the Wonder history owner bonuses are written separately in this column.

At the moment we have already produced historical owner bonuses for all 53 official Wonders. [COLOR:Civ6Yellow]I'm sorry to tell you that because the mod makers in the workshop are so powerful, the number of Wonders mods is far more than expected, so we have canceled the plan to make historical owner bonuses for the Workshop Wonders.[ENDCOLOR][NEWLINE]If you find this mod interesting, please don't forget to give us a thumbs up in Steam Workshop!
